NEW AXIS — the crown badge draws actual INK: the round-3 guard pins `stroke="currentColor"` on the <svg>, but the stroke WIDTH is the sibling paint attribute nothing reads. `stroke-width="0"` leaves the stroke paint, the <path> nodes and their exact `d` data all intact in the DOM, and touches no CSS rule the wrapper-cascade test reads — the badge renders a zero-ink outline, visually identical to the bare colour dot CMX-300 forbids (same mechanism as round 3's stroke="none", one attribute over)

NEW AXIS — the crown badge has a nonzero SIZE: the call site passes the icon's rendered box (`lucideIcon('crown', 12)` -> `width="12" height="12"` on the <svg>). Passing 0 renders a 0x0 icon — path data, stroke paint, title, class and the wrapper's own CSS (display:flex / width:18px, which is on the <span>, not the <svg>; no `.ar-role svg` rule sizes it) are all untouched, so every existing assertion stays green while the colourblind-safe shape cue disappears

NEW AXIS — the badge stays ICON-NARROW through GEOMETRY, not just the `width` declaration: round 2's CSS guard reads only the cascaded `width` (18px). `padding` is the sibling mechanism that regrows the same box (box-sizing:border-box clamps content, not padding), reproducing exactly the ticket's bug — a badge wide enough to truncate the session name beside it — with `getComputedStyle(badge).width` still reporting 18px
